meta.name: how-it-works
meta.description: Explain how claude-mem captures observations, when memory injection kicks in, and where data lives. Use when the user asks "how does claude-mem work?" or "what is this thing doing?".

copy.tagline: 解释 claude-mem 的工作原理与数据存储方式
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果用户常问 claude-mem 如何工作或数据存哪里
copy.tagline_en: Explain how claude-mem works and where data is stored
copy.fit_line_en: For you if users often ask how claude-mem works or where data lives

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能解释 claude-mem 如何运作：读文件、改文件、跑命令都会变成简短观察记录，会话结束做摘要，并把相关记录自动带进后续对话；数据只在本机 ~/.claude-mem，除调用你配置的 AI 服务做整理外不会外传。
howto.when: 当用户问“claude-mem 是怎么工作的？”或“它到底在做什么？”时触发；也适用于问它记录什么、何时注入、数据存哪等机制问题。

say.note: 它会解释读文件、改文件、跑命令怎么变成记录并用于之后对话。

say.text: claude-mem 什么时候会把上次的记忆带进来？
say.note: 它会说从同一项目的第二个会话开始。

say.text: claude-mem 会不会把数据传到外面？
say.note: 它会说数据留本机，只调用你配置的模型服务做整理。

howto.what_en: Claude explains how claude-mem works: reads, edits, and Bash commands become compressed observations, summarized at session end; relevant ones are auto-injected later. Data is local; nothing leaves except compression-provider calls.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks how does claude-mem work? or what is this thing doing? Also fits questions about what it records, when it injects, or where data lives.

say_en.note: It explains how observations are captured and reused later.

say_en.text: When does claude-mem start bringing in past memory?
say_en.note: It says from the second session in a project.
It says data stays local, except calls to your model provider.
